title: Public Site v2
subtitle: maude.sh redesigned in the maude-v2 language — one message, four links, a Maude Cloud buy button, the Advanced docs kept whole
brief:
Redesign of the public site to match maude-v2: simpler navigation, more professional and clearer. A headline in the spirit of "You like Claude? You like Figma? Meet Maude" / "it is Figma but it is yours". Propose a Buy Maude Cloud CTA. Keep the Advanced documentation.

FROZEN 2026-11-04: site/ (site/components/v2, site/app/site-v2.css) is the source of truth from here on. The A0 critic fixes (token radii in fp-*, 44px chips, pressed border, DragFloat cancel, HTML-claim wording, wipe valuetext) were applied in site/, not here.

sections.title: maude.sh, redesigned for Maude 2
sections.subtitle: One message, four links, a Maude Cloud button — and the Advanced docs kept whole

artboards.label: 0 · The message and the map
artboards.note: The three lines (Home headline picked), the navigation before and after (6 links → 4 links + Download + Get Maude Cloud), the site map and three rules.

artboards.label: 1 · Home
artboards.note: Hero headline, the product shot (AI drawing a pricing page next to a sticky), Figma + Claude = Maude, three tiles, It is yours, the dark Maude Cloud band with the €19 price and Get Maude Cloud, the Advanced door, footer. 2026-11-04: the hero is interactive. The headline is a selected layer: Ask Maude chips play a scripted AI rewrite (bolder · for my mum · Czech), ⌘Z puts it back, the stickies drag. New section "Good ol' HTML. The AI knows it best.": a four-beat story for non-technical readers plus a design-to-file wipe slider. Section headlines sharpened.

artboards.label: 2 · Maude Cloud and pricing
artboards.note: New page. Three plans (Self-host free · Cloud Project €19 · Dedicated €99) with Get Maude Cloud as the one primary action, per project vs per seat, trust row, questions, closing CTA. Numbers from docs/cloud/pricing.mdx.

artboards.label: 3 · Docs — two doors
artboards.note: Search, then two doors: Using Maude (no terminal) and Advanced (Explore · Look up · Recipes, every page kept), the four starting points and the latest release.

artboards.label: 4 · An Advanced docs page
artboards.note: The docs layout: Using Maude folded, Advanced open with all its groups, The maude CLI as the example page with a callout back to Using Maude, a command table and a table of contents.

artboards.label: 5 · Home on a phone
artboards.note: The same Home at 390: the nav as one island with Get Cloud and a menu, stacked buttons, a small AI picture, the Cloud band and the Advanced row.

artboards.label: 6 · Intro motion
artboards.note: The hero intro as four frames on the shared clock, and every motion on the site with its tokens and reduced-motion fallback (from the UX research motion patterns).
